routines.name: Nightly DM scan and booking
routines.content:
Weeknights at 10pm in the work timezone, scan email, Slack, LinkedIn, and X for unanswered DMs and real conversations. If the user agreed to a call or meeting and nobody has sent a calendar invite, book it on the work calendar. Title is “Person Name x [user first name]”. Add a Google Meet (or Zoom if that is what they used). Set popup reminders at 1 day, 3 hours, 1 hour, 30 minutes, and 10 minutes. Check both work and personal calendars for conflicts first. Chat the user a short list of what you booked and what still needs them. Never send a separate personalized email. Never reply on Slack/LinkedIn/X unless they asked. Fill-in: [WORK_CALENDAR], [PERSONAL_CALENDAR], [WORK_EMAIL], [PERSONAL_EMAIL].

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 22 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Morning briefing
routines.content:
Weekday morning briefing email, pre-approved. Cover today’s calendar (both calendars, deduped), missed or unanswered email, Slack, LinkedIn, and X. Include a short original story with translations in the language they are learning (fill-in [LEARNING_LANGUAGE]) and a few frontier AI + robotics news items with real links. HTML, scannable, under 400 words. Subject like “Tue · 4 meetings, Celia at 10”. Send from work inbox to work inbox. Then one-line chat ping. Any other email still needs a draft go-ahead. Fill-in: [WORK_EMAIL], [WORK_CALENDAR], [PERSONAL_CALENDAR], [LEARNING_LANGUAGE].

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 41 6 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Evening roundup
routines.content:
Weeknight evening roundup email, pre-approved. Missed important messages across email, Slack, LinkedIn, and X, plus anything they promised and have not sent. Segment by surface. Include From and time. No junk. HTML, short. Send from work inbox to work inbox. Then one-line chat ping. Fill-in: [WORK_EMAIL].

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 21 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
